title: Local unit-root cover of a DVR diagram
statement: Let A and T be discrete valuation ring domains [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], with a local A-algebra structure on T. Let F be a field and the fraction field of T [def-pc-field-extension], with compatible A-algebra structure. Let e>0 be a natural number which is a unit in A and let v be a unit of A. There exist DVR domains A' and T' with local algebra maps A->A', T->T' and A'->T' making the square commute, an element r of A' with r^e=v, and a separable residue extension k(A')/k(A) [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. There also exist a field F', compatible A'- and T'-algebra structures making it the fraction field of T', and a field map iF:F->F' agreeing with both maps out of A and T, such that F' is generated as an A'-algebra by iF(F). No separability or ramification hypothesis on T/A is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0BRM (more-algebra-lemma-abhyankar), first claim of its proof: adjoining a root of the unit and the commutative local DVR square.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sbc-dvr-unit-root-local-square] to obtain A', T', the local square, the root, separable residue extension, injectivity of T->T', and polynomial quotient representatives for every element of T'.

Take a fraction field K of T'. Compose T->T'->K, which is injective. The universal property of the fraction field F of T gives iF:F->K. Its equality on T, the original scalar tower, and commutativity of the local square give its equality on A. Give K the A'-algebra structure through T'.

Let s be the image of the root in K and S=F[s] using iF. Since s^e is the image of v and e>0, s is integral over F. Hence S is integral over a field and closed under inverses. Polynomial induction shows that every T-polynomial in the root maps into S. The polynomial quotient presentation and inverse closure put all of T' in S. Taking quotients once more puts all of K in S. Finally the A'-algebra generated by iF(F) contains the root (as an A' scalar) and all F scalars; it therefore contains S=K. This proves the required algebra-generation equality.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BRM, first claim; the field-generation argument is formalized from polynomial quotient representatives and integrality.

theorem dvr_etale_unit_root_diagram
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    (e : ℕ) (hepos : 0 < e) (he : IsUnit (e : A)) (v : Aˣ)
    (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [IsDomain T] [IsDiscreteValuationRing T]
    [Algebra A T] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A T)]
    (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra A F] [Algebra T F]
    [IsFractionRing T F] [IsScalarTower A T F] :
    ∃ (A' : Type u) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : IsDomain A')
      (_ : IsDiscreteValuationRing A') (aAA' : Algebra A A'),
    letI := aAA'
    ∃ (hAA' : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A A')) (r : A'),
    letI := hAA'
    r ^ e = algebraMap A A' (v : A) ∧
    Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A') ∧
    ∃ (T' : Type u) (_ : CommRing T') (_ : IsDomain T')
      (_ : IsDiscreteValuationRing T') (aTT' : Algebra T T') (aA'T' : Algebra A' T'),
    letI := aTT'
    letI := aA'T'
    ∃ (_ : IsLocalHom (algebraMap T T')) (_ : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A' T')),
    (∀ a : A, algebraMap T T' (algebraMap A T a) =
      algebraMap A' T' (algebraMap A A' a)) ∧
    ∃ (F' : Type u) (_ : Field F') (aA'F' : Algebra A' F') (aT'F' : Algebra T' F'),
    letI := aA'F'
    letI := aT'F'
    ∃ (_ : IsFractionRing T' F') (_ : IsScalarTower A' T' F') (iF : F →+* F'),
    (∀ a : A, iF (algebraMap A F a) = algebraMap A' F' (algebraMap A A' a)) ∧
    (∀ t : T, iF (algebraMap T F t) = algebraMap T' F' (algebraMap T T' t)) ∧
    Algebra.adjoin A' (Set.range iF) = ⊤
